name: Now playing file
description: Writes the current song to a text file, for OBS and other stream overlays.
author: Ruche

settings.label: File
settings.help: Leave empty for now-playing.txt in the plugin's data folder (its path shows in the log).

settings.label: Format
settings.help: Fields: {title} {artist} {album} {year} {station}. Parts with an empty field are dropped.

settings.label: Empty the file when stopped or paused
